# Smeasy — Roster Management for Australian Small Businesses

## About
Smeasy is a lightweight, mobile-first roster management tool designed for Australian hospitality businesses. It helps cafe, bar, and restaurant managers create weekly rosters, manage staff shifts, and handle time-off requests in minutes instead of hours.

## Key Features
- **Quick Roster Creation** — Build a weekly roster in under 5 minutes
- **Mobile-First** — Works perfectly on phones and tablets
- **Staff Notifications** — Publish rosters and staff are notified instantly
- **Time Off Requests** — Staff request days off in-app; you approve with one click
- **Export to Payroll** — Download rosters in formats for Xero and MYOB
- **Shift Management** — Add, edit, or delete shifts on the fly
- **Zero Learning Curve** — No training needed; intuitive for non-technical users

## Target Audience
- Small hospitality businesses (cafes, bars, restaurants, venues)
- Australian managers and owners
- Non-technical users seeking simplicity

## Business Model
- **Free tier:** Up to 10 staff members
- **Pro tier:** $19/month for unlimited staff + SMS notifications

## Use Cases
1. Weekly roster creation and publishing
2. Staff time-off management
3. Last-minute shift coverage
4. Payroll data export
5. Mobile roster management on-the-go

## Content
- Homepage: Landing page with features, pricing, and CTAs
- Guides: Tutorials on roster creation, payroll export, shift scheduling, and mobile tips
- SEO focus: Ranking for "roster management," "shift scheduling," "staff rostering," and related terms

## Technology
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS
- Deployed on Vercel
- Domain: smeasy.au

## Contact & Links
- Website: https://smeasy.au

## Additional Info
Smeasy focuses on solving one problem exceptionally well: making roster management simple, fast, and stress-free for Australian small business managers. It prioritizes simplicity over features, mobile usability over desktop-first design, and local context over generic solutions.
